source: MAFF / ADB, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Bean crop — mung bean and black gram], official cultivation manual, 2005 (black gram sections)
text: Black gram shares the same pest and disease complex profiled for mung bean in this manual — Cercospora leaf spot, powdery mildew, mosaic virus disease; and aphid, cutworm, bean pod borer, leaf-footed bug/stink bug complex, whitefly, and mealybug as the main insect pests — with the manual noting that management recommendations (cultural practice and named pesticide products) are essentially shared across both crops given their close relatedness and similar growth habit.
